<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 224.120 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral mass of ~223.113 Da. A formula that matches this mass is C₁₆H₁₅O (exact mass 223.1123 Da), which fits within the instrument tolerance. Therefore the molecular formula of the sample compound is C16H15O.</thought>
<final_answer>C16H15O</final_answer>
